configuration.title: OpenCode CLI Sidebar
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.fontF: Terminal font family (Nerd Font recommended for Powerline/glyph support)
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.focus: Controls when the terminal view highlights its borders to indicate keyboard focus. 'off' disables the indicator, 'bottomBorder' highlights only the bottom edge, and 'fullBorder' highlights all edges.
Width of the focus indicator border in pixels. Only applies when focusIndicatorMode is not 'off'.
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.scrol: Maximum number of lines in scrollback buffer
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.autoF: Automatically focus the OpenCode CLI Sidebar after sending file references or text
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.autoS: Automatically start OpenCode when the sidebar is opened.
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.shell: Custom shell path to use for the terminal. Leave empty to use VS Code's default shell. Useful for specifying PowerShell, Git Bash, or other shells on Windows.
Custom arguments to pass to the shell. Leave empty for automatic detection. Example: ["/c"] for cmd.exe or ["-Command"] for PowerShell.
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.sendK: Send Ctrl/Cmd + letter shortcuts (including Ctrl+P) directly to the sidebar terminal instead of letting VS Code intercept them. This extension's main purpose is running opencode (a TUI with its own keybindings), so the default is ON. You can turn it off if you prefer normal IDE shortcuts even when the sidebar terminal is focused. Control keys like Ctrl+C are always sent to the terminal.
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.follo: Use VS Code's terminal theme for the OpenCode TUI. When enabled, the extension sets OpenCode's theme name and mode to system, overriding a local theme choice. Disable to use OpenCode's own theme settings.
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.autoS: Share live editor context (open files, selections) with OpenCode via the editor-context WebSocket. Takes effect when the AI tool session is (re)started (restart command, reopen sidebar, or window reload).
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.httpT: HTTP API request timeout in milliseconds for communication with OpenCode
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.enabl: Enable HTTP API for bidirectional communication between VS Code and OpenCode
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.logLe: Log output level for OpenCode CLI Sidebar
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.enabl: Auto-spawn an OpenCode instance when none is discovered
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.codeA: Diagnostic severities that trigger code actions
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.openc: Path or command used to launch the OpenCode CLI.
Additional command-line arguments passed to the OpenCode CLI.
Continue the last OpenCode session when the terminal starts.
configuration.opencode-cli-sidebar.updat: Hours between automatic OpenCode update checks
Enable WebDAV sync of OpenCode configuration files.
WebDAV account name used for sign-in.
Folder on the WebDAV server that stores the synced configuration.
Allow plain HTTP connections to the WebDAV server. Traffic will not be encrypted.
Skip certificate validation for self-signed WebDAV server certificates.
Master switch for all automatic sync triggers.
Run one sync when the extension starts.
Sync after local configuration files change.
Periodically check the WebDAV server for remote changes.
Minutes between remote change checks. Minimum 1.
Maximum WebDAV requests allowed per rate limit window. Use 0 for no limit; default 600.
Length of the rate limit window in minutes. Minimum 1.
Show sync status on the config sync toolbar button.
Additional files or folders inside the OpenCode config folder to sync.
Sync item paths that are currently turned off.
Files or folders inside the OpenCode config folder that are never synced, even when a sync item covers them.
What to do when local and remote copies changed at the same time: prompt, preferLocal, or preferRemote.
What to do when a file was deleted on one side: prompt for a decision or ignore the deletion.
